mode: built-in image_gen, one call per relic
constraints: 32x32, six shared palette colors including outline, two-pixel outline, minimum two-pixel transparent margins, drafts only

tasks.name: 작열하는 송곳
tasks.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single 32x32 pixel-art relic icon for a Unity 2D fantasy roguelike.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and establishes the object's recognizable design and orientation. Input image 2 is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, an already approved fire relic. Do not copy the heart shape from image 2.
Redraw the target as deliberate low-resolution pixel art with the same clean, chunky visual style as the approved reference. Use broad contiguous flat color clusters, simple readable planes, restrained highlights, no dithering, no isolated texture pixels, no gradients, no glossy rendering, no antialiasing. Preserve overall design; improve silhouette and simplify interior.
The intended logical canvas is EXACTLY 32x32. Draw on a visibly coarse 32x32 grid with perfectly square aligned pixels; an integer enlarged representation is acceptable, but no high-resolution detail. All object pixels including outline stay in x=2..29 and y=2..29, leaving at least TWO transparent logical pixels on all four sides. Outer outline is a consistent TWO logical pixels thick, dark charcoal, using compact stair steps. Keep proportions natural, never stretch the object to fill width.
Use ONLY these SIX opaque colors including the outline: charcoal #363232; muted red shadow #A75064; red #E55C5C; orange #E09656; yellow #EECF5A; warm cream #F1E9D4. Use all six meaningfully, with cream limited to a small hot highlight. Outline remains charcoal. These are the complete palette; no additional colors.
Background is genuinely transparent. Show exactly one isolated finished icon, centered, with no grid overlay, no labels, no frame, no drop shadow or external glow.

Subject: SCORCHING AWL. Keep the target's long diagonal tool silhouette pointing toward the lower left, with a thickened tapered red-hot spike, a compact orange/yellow crosswise head at the upper right and a short stub handle projecting toward the upper right. It must read as one solid glowing awl, not a feather, a flame blob, a sword with a long blade guard, or a wand. Keep the shaft broad enough for a few purposeful interior color bands and the tip clear at 32x32. No extra flying sparks.
